notes: Found no refundable Loop room under $250, then surfaced a $176 free-cancellation rate out by O'Hare and reached the booking form.
Found a $365 fare with a Sunday morning return and a $465 one that fit the schedule, booked nothing and asked which constraint to relax.
Picked a $32 hand-wrapped bouquet with same-day delivery and the gift note in place, landing at about $46 all in.
Reached the florist checkout but has no way to hold or enter a card itself, so the user must pay on the merchant page.
Pulled the right Gmail thread, flagged a real calendar clash, and sent the reply from the user's own account after asking.
Reads and replies in Gmail through a per-action permission prompt, but the set of connected apps trails the leaders.
Refused card details in chat, kept payment on the merchant page, and asked before sending the email.
